# Gonzalo Torres Rosales

## Sociology of Wealth, Inequality & Educational Trajectories

I am a PhD candidate in Sociology at Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile. My research examines how household wealth, debt, and economic security shape unequal educational futures in Chile.

[Research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [GitHub](https://github.com/gonzalotr11){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

## Research agenda

My work studies wealth not only as a stock of resources, but as a configuration of assets, liabilities, liquidity, collateral, and intertemporal security. I am especially interested in how these configurations shape family capacities to absorb shocks, plan for the future, and sustain educational trajectories.

::: {.grid}
::: {.card}
### Wealth configurations

Assets and debts as structured forms of advantage and vulnerability.
:::

::: {.card}
### Economic security

How households manage uncertainty, shocks, and future-oriented decisions.
:::

::: {.card}
### Educational inequality

How wealth and security shape school and higher education trajectories.
:::
:::

## Current projects

::: {.project-card}
### Household Wealth Configurations and the Unequal Security of Family Futures in Chile

Doctoral research project focused on measuring wealth configurations and examining their consequences for economic security and educational trajectories.
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Wealth reconstruction using survey data and machine learning

Methodological work on estimating patrimonial conditions across surveys and administrative data.
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Subjective economic hardship in Chile

Analysis of economic insecurity, age profiles, income position, housing tenure, and debt burden using EBS 2023.
:::
